relevance_note: The paper describes an identifiable in-scope person with succinic semialdehyde dehydrogenase deficiency ('we present a patient with a severe phenotype of SSADHD caused by a novel genetic variant c.728T > C') with individual-level detail, so reports_individuals_with_tnfaip3_variant is true.
method_note: Read only the paper, schema, rules and instructions. No script transcribed any table; every cell was hand-copied and re-checked against the paper. In scope: the one first-hand patient with SSADHD (compound heterozygous c.278G > T and c.728T > C) plus the four relatives named in the family history (mother, father, paternal uncle, one healthy brother); no variants are described for any relative. Table 2 is a literature table of ALDH5A1 missense variants (one variant per row, with a Source column) but it describes no person with individual-level data (no sex, age or feature), so no individuals rows and no variants rows were built from it, and no source_reference_in_review value exists for it; the paper's '62 ALDH5A1 missense variants from 20 publications' are variant counts, not patients, so publications.cohort_size_as_stated is null. No stacked cells (' / ') occur in any table of this paper. publications.cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is false (the paper nowhere states that its patient was published before) and therefore has no span. Uncertainties I had to resolve: (1) ataxia was set excluded for the patient from 'the patient developed a wide-based gait without further cerebellar signs'; (2) dystonia was left not reported because the paper only says the leg stiffening was 'probably due to a mild generalized dystonia or a more unspecific “central tone-coordination disorder”'; (3) intellectual disability was set observed from 'Her cognitive abilities are heterogeneous and impaired by autistic and possibly some features of dyspraxia'; (4) pathogenicity 'pathogenic' for c.278G > T relies on 'compound heterozygosity for a known pathogenic variant as well as a novel variant' together with the paper calling c.278G > T the known and c.728T > C the novel variant; (5) transcript_as_stated NM_001080.3 comes from the Methods statement that the variant description 'corresponds to transcript ID NM_001080.3'; (6) consanguinity 'no' for the brother is taken from the shared-parents statement 'born at term to non-consanguineous parents'; (7) zygosity 'compound heterozygous' was used for both of the patient's variants because the paper states compound heterozygosity for the patient, although it also says 'heterozygosity for a known missense variant, c.278G > T'. For the brother the paper says only “one healthy brother”, which is not a named clinical feature, so no phenotypic_features row and no checklist status was set from it. No contradictions inside the paper were found.
